# FlutterFoot Books

> FlutterFoot Books is a general bookstore for every reader — from first stories to next chapters. Coming Soon.
> Tagline: Celebrating the little kid inside all of us.
> Website: https://flutterfoot.com/
> Contact: flutterfootllc@gmail.com
> Copyright: Copyright © 2026 FlutterFoot Enterprises

## About

FlutterFoot Books is a general bookstore for all ages and genres, not just for kids. The homepage is a Coming Soon teaser — no book titles, prices, or pre-orders are listed yet.

## For every age, every stage

- Ages 0-8
- Ages 9-12
- Teens & YA
- Adults

## Genre shelves (Coming Soon)

- Children's & Picture Books
- Fiction / Mystery / Adventure
- Non-fiction & Ideas
- Home / Family / Lifestyle
- Wellbeing & New Chapters
- Teens / YA & Coming-of-Age

## Free printables

Five free black-and-white activity sheets, each with colouring, counting/tracing, mazes or dot-to-dots and a draw-your-own frame:

- The Reading Fox
- Bunny's Bedtime
- The Rainy-Day Dragon
- The Balloon Parade
- Owl's Story Time

Each sheet carries the footer: Copyright © 2026 FlutterFoot Enterprises • flutterfoot.com

## Readers Club

Visitors can join the Readers Club for launch news, with a name, email address, and reading interest (children's, fiction, non-fiction/lifestyle, YA).

## Fortune cookie

The homepage has a fortune-cookie picker that matches a visitor to a genre shelf.
